title: Recording: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings finished recording the Venus And Mars song ‘Spirits Of Ancient Egypt’ on 17 March 1975.

Denny Laine had struggled to hit a high note in the chorus. Keen to wrap up the song, Paul McCartney joined him at the microphone to take over on that line.

With all the songs believed to be complete, although there was a final overdub recorded on 22 March, studio engineer Alan O’Duffy began creating rough mixes of the whole album at the end of the session.
